build_RCNN3D_model: build a 3D cuboid detection model from a Detectron2 config using build_model
build_RCNN3D_backbone: build a backbone network from config using build_backbone for the RCNN3D model
run_RCNN3D_inference: run 3D object detection inference on batched image inputs with camera intrinsics
run_RCNN3D_training_forward: run the training forward pass of RCNN3D to compute proposal and detector losses
visualize_RCNN3D_training: visualize 2D bounding boxes and 3D cuboid predictions during RCNN3D training
